definitions.crash: close falls to <= 30% of the day's close within 90 days (series) / study-specific for reused outputs
definitions.trust:
Stats helpers for the cross-detector backtest harness (stdlib only).
Trust tiers (applied identically to every detector, reused or replayed):
  proven   : leading signal, enough sample (case-control: >= 30 cases, >= 20 controls, >= 10 flagged cases; forward: >= 30 flagged
             events with >= 10 hits), p < 0.01 (or p < 0.05 with >= 100 cases / 300 events),
             and a real effect (lift >= 1.5, or AUC >= 0.65 / <= 0.35 for continuous scores).
  weak     : tested, but only partly meets the bar (small n, borderline p, coincident-only timing, or tested and found no edge;
             `edge` says which).
  untested : no historical data, too few positives (< 10), or no comparison group.
definitions.p: replays: max(event binomial, token-cluster bootstrap) — conservative

same_family_control_knn_and_similarity.note: not independent; shown to illustrate that correlated detectors do not add up

confluence.note: Calibrated on research-DB static flags (mint/freeze authority, LP unlocked, holder/insider concentration, serial deployer) because those are the only independent detectors observed together on the same historical tokens. Live confluence precision accrues in data/fplog.json and overrides this when n >= 30.
